list: 55 official trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.missableBasis: Platinum for earning the other 54; nothing in the description names a one-time moment.
trophies.guide: The platinum pops when the other 54 are done. It is the last trophy by definition, so plan the run around A Long Road and the one possibly missable meditation, not around this trophy itself.

steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum unlocks automatically once the last one pops.
Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation early (see Positive Mental Attitude) — it is the only step the guides flag as possibly missable.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.missableBasis: Automatic story trophy; the official description names a mission that plays once and cannot be skipped past.
trophies.guide: The opening mission. It unlocks on its own as the story starts.

steps.t: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1; the trophy pops when it ends.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.missableBasis: Automatic story trophy for finishing a chapter; no one-time moment is named.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Before leaving it, do the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude.

steps.t: Finish every main mission of Chapter 1; the trophy pops at the chapter's end.
Before Chapter 1 ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.missableBasis: Automatic story trophy for finishing a chapter; no one-time moment is named.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. This is when both characters become playable and the partner trophies open up.

steps.t: Finish every main mission of Chapter 2; the trophy pops at the chapter's end.
From here you can switch between Jason and Lucia, which the partner trophies need.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.missableBasis: Automatic story trophy for finishing a chapter; no one-time moment is named.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Robbery tools arrive in this stretch, so start the shop and jewelry jobs when they appear.

steps.t: Finish every main mission of Chapter 3; the trophy pops at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.missableBasis: Automatic story trophy for finishing a chapter; no one-time moment is named.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The bank-vault mission near its end unlocks the big robbery trophies.

steps.t: Finish every main mission of Chapter 4; the trophy pops at the chapter's end.
Watch for the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — it opens bank vault robberies.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missableBasis: Automatic story trophy for the final mission; no one-time moment is named.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Keep a manual save from just before it: there is no mission replay, so a save is the only way back.

steps.t: Play through the story to the final mission and finish it; the gold pops at the end.
Keep a manual save from before the final mission — the game has no mission replay and 15 manual save slots.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missableBasis: Automatic story trophy for a named mission; no one-time moment is named.
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run. It is the mission after which switching between the two characters opens up.

steps.t: Play the story until Breakfast Run appears and finish it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missableBasis: Automatic story trophy for a named mission; no one-time moment is named.
trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist in the story.

steps.t: Play the story until The Cartel Heist appears and finish it.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missableBasis: Automatic story trophy for a named mission; no one-time moment is named.
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play in the story.

steps.t: Play the story until Child's Play appears and finish it.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.missableBasis: Automatic story trophy for a named mission; no one-time moment is named.
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners in the story.

steps.t: Play the story until Headliners appears and finish it.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.missableBasis: Automatic story trophy for a named mission; no one-time moment is named.
trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown in the story.

steps.t: Play the story until VCIA Takedown appears and finish it.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missableBasis: Automatic story trophy for a named mission; no one-time moment is named.
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory in the story.

steps.t: Play the story until Operation Savage Glory appears and finish it.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names a checklist, not a one-time moment; guides agree nothing on it is missable.
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy: the in-game 100% checklist, which only opens after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, though progress made during the story already counts. It is far from true 100% — roughly 60% of the game — with lenient thresholds on most lines.

steps.t: Finish the story first; the checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and earlier progress already counts.
Do any 100 optional missions (there are far more than 100, so a few missed ones do not matter).
Scan any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles with WAiNK and study any 100 of 255 animals with binoculars.
Complete 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, all 39 gang operations, all 8 bank vaults and 15 of 18 card sets.
Note the time estimates disagree: PowerPyx and KeenGamer put the platinum near 200 hours, Push Square up to 300 hours or more.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names a count, not a one-time moment; stunts stay on the map after the story.
trophies.guide: Do any 250 of the 397 stunts. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this trophy if you are chasing A Long Road.

steps.t: Mix the four kinds — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps — and pick the easiest ones.
Track them under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.
Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest to repeat; the 100% checklist needs 300 stunts, not 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names trying each type once; activities stay available after the story.
trophies.guide: Do each of the 9 activity types once. Most happen naturally while working on other trophies.

steps.t: Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see the 9 types and how many of each you have done.
Cover fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race, and performing a stunt.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names a count of challenges; ranges stay open after the story.
trophies.guide: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 range locations. The 100% checklist needs all 42 too, so this is not skippable.

steps.t: Visit the 12 Shooting Range locations and work through their challenges until each shows gold.
The 100% checklist also needs all 42 gold medals, so there is no shortcut around this one.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names winning at every location; races stay available after the story.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. There are 42 drone races in total, and the 100% checklist wants all 42 time trials done.

steps.t: Win at least one drone race at each of the 14 Top Fun locations.
For the 100% checklist, finish all 42 drone time trials across those locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names a count of different races; races stay available after the story.
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, and the 100% checklist wants 30 of them won.

steps.t: Win races at 20 different locations out of the 40 unique race spots.
Keep going to 30 wins if you are chasing the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names beating a character in a challenge; the questline stays available.
trophies.guide: Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in a fishing challenge.

steps.t: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), wait for Cal's text marking a fishing spot with a purple icon.
Follow his fishing questline and beat him in the challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names completing one arcade game; the games stay playable after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish all levels of any one of the 4 arcade games. You do not need to beat every challenge in it, just reach the end.

steps.t: Pick one of Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck.
The first three play on the TV at home (from Chapter 1); Bang For Your Buck is at arcade machines around the world.
Finish all of its levels once; beating every challenge is not required.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names a final mission for a character; guides say the questline stays available after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's 5-quest line. It is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3, and it stays available after the story.

steps.t: In Chapter 3, as Lucia, wait for Andy's call, then follow her texts to her home in Belville.
Complete her 5 quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names a final mission for a character; guides say the questline returns after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving line: 7 shipwrecks in total. He goes quiet for a stretch in Chapter 1 and comes back later, so do not panic if he vanishes.

steps.t: After the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams, wait for Kenton's call, then find his green KR icon in Key Lento.
Dive the shipwrecks he marks, using the metal detector to dig treasure from the ocean floor, and bring each set back to him.
After the first set he calls you back for more; clear 7 shipwrecks in total. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names a final mission for a character; guides say the questline stays available after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's 5-quest line at the Thrillbilly Mud Club. It opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.

steps.t: After Coffee Break, go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County where Billy's line is marked.
Complete his 5 quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, Hometown Heroes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names 8 strands; no strand is named as one-time, but one timed race is flagged as a watch item below.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands. Only certain questlines count — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's have their own trophies and do not count here — and not every strand is confirmed yet.

steps.t: Do the confirmed counting strands: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete.
Watch: Yago's Chapter 3 street race (Race Against Yago) carries an hourglass icon — save first, then race the moment it appears.
Unconfirmed: more strands beyond the four named ones count, but which ones is still being worked out — check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names a final mission for a character; guides say the wishlist stays doable after the story.
trophies.guide: Deliver the sports cars on Randy's wish list. You unlock the Key Cloner during the Chapter 3 mission that introduces him, and the list stays open after the story.

steps.t: After the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, Randy gives you a list of 16 sports cars he wants.
Steal the cars he marks (or any matching car off the street), scan them with WAiNK to check the list, and drive each to his garage in west Vice City.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names a final mission for a character; guides say the labs stay available after the story.
trophies.guide: Destroy Tyrone's synthetic labs, then finish his second quest. The line is Jason-only and opens in Chapter 3.

steps.t: After the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, as Jason, follow the purple markers to the Synthetic Labs in Vice City.
Destroy the labs (quest Take Out Kitty Litter) until Tyrone gives you Spin On This, then finish that quest.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableBasis: Official description asks for every spot; PowerPyx reports the first meditation is offered only in Chapter 1 at Jason's house.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. This is the one trophy every guide flags as possibly missable, because of a single Chapter 1 meditation — and whether that meditation is even required is itself unsettled.

steps.t: Possibly missable: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept to meditate.

Sources disagree — PowerPyx says the balcony meditation adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a spot, so it is unclear if it is required [3]; OutputLag says it counts and disappears after Chapter 1 [7]; eGamers says its author is not sure it counts [9]. Do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save.
Meditate at the other spots with both characters — each spot counts twice, once per character — and track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 meditations are needed, so the checklist does not settle whether the Chapter 1 one is required.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names hunting one unique animal; guides say the questline stays available after the story.
trophies.guide: Work through Bret Vogel's hunting line as Jason. He hands you a unique rifle, and the line is about his requested animals — but which animal actually pops the trophy is still being confirmed.

steps.t: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, as Jason, wait for Bret's text marking Veteran Hunted in Lummox County.
Do his quests and bring the requested animals back to him; he gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle on the first quest.
Unconfirmed: PowerPyx says it is still being confirmed which animal exactly unlocks this trophy — finish his line and check the trophy after each hunt.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names a count of sets; cards stay collectible after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets (480 cards in total). The 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so this trophy comes early on that road.

steps.t: Collect cards until 3 full sets are complete — the smallest sets are the cheapest way there.
There are 480 cards across 18 sets; the 100% checklist needs 15 sets, at least 372 cards in total.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names a count of locations; scans stay available after the story.
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations. There are more than 100, so scan whatever you pass.

steps.t: Hold up on the D-pad to open WAiNK, then hold R1 on landmarks, curiosities and sculptures to scan them.
The split is 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags — any 100 scans count.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names a count of challenges; challenges stay available after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way there.

steps.t: Track challenges under Progress > Challenges; most complete naturally while working on other trophies.
Leave this for late, then pick the easiest remaining ones — you only need 50 of 80, and 70 of 80 for the checklist.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names losing a wanted level with a partner; it can be repeated until it pops.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, reach 4 stars and escape the red heat zone — not just the flashing search area. It also pops on its own during the big bank-vault robberies.

steps.t: Sources differ on when you can play together — PowerPyx puts free switching after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break [3]; OutputLag puts switching right after Breakfast Run [7]. Try after Breakfast Run; if the partner call is not offered yet, finish Coffee Break.
Call your partner (hold right, press triangle), cause carnage to 4 stars, then escape on a fast motorcycle — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia is a good escape route.
The trophy pops only after you leave the red heat zone. Robbing a large bank vault also gives 4 stars with your partner, so it may pop there on its own.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names robbing 3 shops in a row; it can be repeated until it pops.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while the wanted level stays up. The pop is delayed by about 30 seconds, so do not judge it too early — and a 4th shop sometimes seals it.

steps.t: Sources differ on when you can play together — PowerPyx puts free switching after Coffee Break [3]; OutputLag puts switching right after Breakfast Run [7]. Try after Breakfast Run; if the partner call is not offered yet, finish Coffee Break.
Call your partner, then hit 3 robbery targets in a row while the red/blue flashing wanted level stays up — if the stars fade to only the red heat zone, the chain breaks.
A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs; loot a couple of items and the back-room safe in each.
Wait about 30 seconds after leaving the 3rd shop; if it has not popped, hit a 4th shop and keep going.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names a count of vehicles; scanning stays available after the story.
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with WAiNK — you do not need to drive them. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned.

steps.t: Open WAiNK (hold up) and scan vehicles as they pass — stand on a busy road and scan everything new.
Scanning is enough; driving is not required. Track totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names one use of Combat Focus; it can be repeated until it pops.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies inside a single Combat Focus. Buff your focus first, pick a group of gang enemies, and use a full-auto rifle.

steps.t: Activate Combat Focus with L3 + R3 while aiming; it slows time and drains the purple focus bar.
Buff focus first with food, drinks or Adrenaline (Adrenaline extends the slow time), and wear body armor.
Line up 5 gang enemies — PowerPyx reports it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians — and drop them with an assault rifle like the Duke 556.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names a departure at the airport; the planes stay there after the story.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge at VCIA, reverse it out, take off and fly away. Only docked planes count — not the ones parked on the airfield.

steps.t: Go to VCIA and find a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal — the E3/E4 gates are the easiest.
Enter through the stairs by the boarding bridge, go upstairs to the cockpit, drive backward to the strip and take off.
Fly about 1 km away from the airport; the pop is delayed until you are that far out.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.missableBasis: Official description is a joke line about Rhinos (tanks); the tanks stay at their base after the story.
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station and use it in combat until the trophy pops.

steps.t: Go to Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map; the tanks stand in the south of the base.
Drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), get in a tank and shoot enemies until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names an undetected robbery; stores can be robbed again after the story.
trophies.guide: Break into a jewelry store through its back door with the Snap Gun, loot the safe, kill the alarm and the footage, and leave unseen.

steps.t: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies.
Use the Snap Gun on a locked back door (kicking it sets off the alarm), find the safe code note in the back room, open the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm.
Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; the trophy pops shortly after you leave.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names a count of vaults; vaults stay robbable after the story.
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape. The 100% checklist wants all 8, so this pops on that road — and each vault can pay up to $205,000.

steps.t: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — it introduces vault robberies.
Tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the guard has the vault open, and bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone.
After that quest, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (after his earlier Payday Loan jobs) to find more vaults; each robbery gives 4 stars instantly.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names robbing one armored truck; trucks keep driving around Vice City.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the red heat zone. It pops on its own during the bank-vault introduction, or earlier by stopping a truck on the street.

steps.t: Easiest: do the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… — robbing the vault counts as robbing the armored truck.
Earlier method: block a truck near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names exploring the whole state; the map stays open after the story.
trophies.guide: Unfog the whole map of Leonida. A plane is the fastest way to sweep the fogged areas.

steps.t: Fly a plane over every area still black with fog on the map until the whole state is visible.
Check the map as you go — the PSN target is all 52 areas of Leonida.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names one operation per gang; operations stay available after the story.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total, and the 100% checklist wants all of them.

steps.t: Find operations by their yellow map icons when nearby; many are also marked from story progress.
Track each gang under Progress > Gangs — it shows how many of their operations you have robbed.
Group gangs by region and clear them in a few long drives instead of zigzagging across Leonida.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names a cocktail with a view; the bar stays open after the story.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. One guide gives an exact method; another says the exact trigger is still being confirmed — so treat the method below as reported, not settled.

steps.t: Sources disagree — PowerPyx reports: go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini and drink it standing next to the bar [3]; KeenGamer says the exact trigger is still being confirmed [5].
Unconfirmed: if the bar method does not pop it, try other rooftop bars with a view on Ocean Beach and check the trophy after each drink.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names smashing out of a showroom; showrooms stay open after the story.
trophies.guide: Steal one specific car from one specific showroom and drive it through the window. One guide gives the exact car; another says the exact method is still unconfirmed.

steps.t: Sources disagree — PowerPyx reports: take the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City, after getting the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, then drive forward straight through the window [3]; KeenGamer says the exact method is still unconfirmed [5].
Unconfirmed: the pop is slightly delayed and comes after you drive further away on the street — and only that blue Banshee is reported to work.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names the bowling alley; guides report the robbery icon respawns, so it is not missable.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn and escape the police. If you miss one during the mission, the robbery icon respawns later — it is not missable.

steps.t: Go to Kingpin Bowling during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling; buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation first.
Take the 3 valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs).
The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item; killing enemies is not needed.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableBasis: Official description is a joke line about a partnership; training stays available after the story.
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with Jason and Lucia at the same time. Train together: while one works out, the other finishes their training automatically.

steps.t: Only possible after both characters are playable (Chapter 2 onward); check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia for each character.
Buy a gym membership, bring your partner (hold right, press triangle), and work out together — the partner trains alongside you.
You can also work out at home after the story; filter for fitness clubs on Map > Activities.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names choices made; the counter fills passively across the whole run.
trophies.guide: Do 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. It fills passively through robberies and fights, so do not grind it early — check it last.

steps.t: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) so you can see each action register.

Every robbery and enemy encounter counts; the profile runs Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho, up to Irredeemable — the last one is permanent, so avoid excessive violence if you do not want cops shooting on sight.
If it is still short at the end, it can be farmed quickly — but only as a last resort, since it pushes your profile toward Psycho.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableBasis: Official description is a joke line with no action named; no source confirms a one-time moment.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed. The only published guess ties it to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — treat that as a guess, not a method.

steps.t: Unconfirmed: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue [3]; KeenGamer lists its unlock method as unconfirmed [5].
Single-source guess: try the Payday Loans store a second time — 'second time's the charm' — and check the trophy; do not build a plan around it until a second source confirms it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableBasis: Official description is a joke line with no action named; the reported method can be retried, so no one-time moment is claimed.
trophies.guide: A UFO easter egg, by one guide's report — but another guide lists the method as still unconfirmed, so treat the steps below as one guide's report, not settled fact.

steps.t: Sources disagree — PowerPyx reports a UFO easter egg: at night after 2AM, alone, on the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County [3]; KeenGamer lists this trophy's method as unconfirmed [5].
If a blinking car is at the roadside, follow the path into the woods toward the bright blue light, approach the UFO, talk to the woman it drops and help her back to her car.
The spawn is slightly random and not guaranteed — if the car is not there, drive away and come back.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names a melee drive-by; no source confirms a one-time moment.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed. The only published guess is knocking people over with a melee attack from a moving motorcycle — treat that as a guess, not a method.

steps.t: Unconfirmed: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking people while driving a motorcycle [3]; KeenGamer says the precise method is still being confirmed [5].
Single-source guess: try melee drive-by kicks from a motorcycle and check the trophy; do not build a plan around it until a second source confirms it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names a cumulative dollar total; laundering stays available after the story.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. The total is cumulative across robberies, and one bank vault can pay up to $205,000 in a single job.

steps.t: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
The $250,000 counts across all robberies, not in one trip; it comes naturally while doing the robberies for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names a cumulative dollar total; shops stay open after the story.
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way there, since they are the most expensive.

steps.t: Spend across any shops — the total is cumulative across every kind of shop.

Fastest: guns, car mods and tattoos. The game has 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names purchasing garage properties; they stay buyable after the story.
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages ($160,000 in total) through the Vice City Real Estate phone app. The 4 story garages do not count.

steps.t: Garages open for purchase after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses); the Real Estate app is installed on your phone then.
Buy the 8 purchasable garages through the app — $160,000 in total; robberies in Chapters 3–4 are the quickest way to fund them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.missableBasis: Official description names registering 10 vehicles; registration stays available after the story.
trophies.guide: Register 10 stolen vehicles through the Scooter Bros app. Buy garages first — each one adds the parking spots you need to register more vehicles.

steps.t: The Scooter Bros app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses).
Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray.
Keep costs low with cheap low-end cars and bikes; each vehicle needs a free garage space, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes).
